cohort: Women with Pompe disease, recruited through the German and UK sections of the International Pompe Association and the German Pompe Group
finding: Women with Pompe disease do not appear to have an increased risk of pregnancy or delivery complications compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Women with Pompe disease do not appear to have an increased risk of pregnancy or delivery complications, including Cesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was not significantly different between women with and without Pompe disease symptoms, or compared to the general population.
